summary: China SXT Pharmaceuticals filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement under an effective shelf for an up-to-$9M marketed unit offering, priced at $1.50 per unit of one Class A ordinary share (or pre-funded warrant) plus one ordinary warrant. The October 8, 2026 securities purchase agreement includes a $12M over-allotment option exercisable for 30 days post-closing. Warrants strike at $2.75, expire one year after initial exercise, and carry a zero-price exercise feature with a $0.50 floor. No board recommendation or advisor is named; an underwriter is not identified in the excerpt. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
